info.title: eBillAddress public API
info.description: What an installed Marketplace app may do for the organisation that installed it. Every call carries the app's access token; each route needs the scope named in x-ebill-scope, granted at install.

x-ebill-scopes.label: See documents you send and what happened to them
Download the files on your documents
Record payments and answer them in your name
Read the bills you choose to share with it from your browser

get.summary: The installation this token was issued for.
The values the organisation saved on this app's settings page.
The organisation's documents of one direction, newest first. Outgoing needs documents:read; incoming, documents:received:read.
One document. Not found unless the app may read documents of its direction.
A file on a document, by its position: always a download.
An invoice's payment, and the payment events it is made of.

post.summary: A new draft of any kind, from one of the organisation's own addresses.
Sign and send a draft. Needs an Idempotency-Key: a retried send is never sent twice.

get.summary: Who may send to whom: the organisation's trusts.

post.summary: Trade an authorisation code, or a refresh token, with the app's client id and secret, for an access and a refresh token.

bearer.description: The installation's access token (ebat_…), from the install flow.

currency.description: ISO 4217. Every amount on the invoice is in it.

description.description: The notes: up to 2000 characters in up to 50 lines of plain text, formatted by marks in the text (rich-text.ts), never HTML.

encrypted.description: Whether it travels encrypted: true when left out. Sent only the way the receiver allows (EBA_DOCUMENT_PRIVACY_NOT_ALLOWED otherwise).

fromAddress.description: One of your own addresses. It cannot be changed afterwards: write a new draft to send from another.

lineItems.description: Up to 100. A draft may have none; an invoice that is sent has at least one.

template.description: A template's handle (documentTemplates): the draft is drawn with its newest release, resolved each time it is saved. None when left out. EBA_TEMPLATE_UNAVAILABLE for one not in the Marketplace; EBA_DOCUMENT_INVALID, TEMPLATE_KIND at template, for one that does not draw this kind.

anyOf.description: By kind: lineItems, taxTotals and description; receipt; letter; or payslip.

sample.description: A sample eBill put in a sandbox for your app to read. Nobody sent it. Only ever true in a sandbox.

amountMinor.description: What comes off before tax; the line's other amounts are already net of it. A PERCENT's is checked.

percent.description: With PERCENT only: more than 0, at most 100, up to two decimals.

discount.description: A discount on this line; or, with invoiceDiscount, what the whole invoice's takes off.

invoiceDiscount.description: The whole invoice's discount: described "Discount" or "Discount 10%", quantity "1", its amounts negative (the tax taken off), after every other line, one for each tax category. Not with discounts on lines.

lineTotalMinor.description: What this line adds to the total, tax included.

quantity.description: A decimal, as text: up to nine digits, and up to six after the point.

taxAmountMinor.description: The tax inside lineTotalMinor. 0 for none.

taxCategory.description: A short code, 1 to 40 letters, digits and _ . : % -. "none" for no tax.

error.description: A code: unauthorized, insufficient_scope, not_found, invalid_request, invalid_idempotency_key, …

reference.description: Quote it to eBill's support: it finds this request's log.

category.description: A code: lower case letters, digits and _, or one under a prefix (au:penalty).

fundName.description: The fund it is paid to.

unit.description: hour, year, and so on: a code.

name.description: Your own name for the total, e.g. gross or tax.

amountMinor.description: More than 0. Less than the receipt's total is a part payment; more is refused when it is sent.

method.description: card, bank_transfer, cash, or a code under a prefix (au:bpay): lower case letters, digits and _.

reference.description: Your reference for the payment, up to 100 characters.

ReceiptPaymentInput.description: What a receipt records was paid.

expires_in.description: Seconds the access token works for.

reference.description: Quote it to eBill's support: it finds this request's log.

client_secret.description: The app's client secret (ebcs_…). Only ever sent from the app's server.

code.description: authorization_code: the code (ebac_…) the redirect URL was given. Works once, for ten minutes.

redirect_uri.description: authorization_code: the redirect URL the code was sent to, exactly.

refresh_token.description: refresh_token: the refresh token (ebrt_…). Works once; the answer has a new one.
